disclosure: Several 'Spring ... Trends' articles exist. Took the first site-search result (harpersbazaar.com/search/?q=Spring+Fashion+Trends, seq 7, relevance order): 'The Best Spring 2025 Fashion Trends to Shop Now'. The five brands are the first five luxury houses named in the article's intro prose (Loewe, Alaïa, Miu Miu, Bottega Veneta, Saint Laurent); the article names many more (Prada, Versace, Valentino, Chloé, Fendi, etc.), so which five is a choice. Search results page reached by direct nav to the site's /search/ URL.
